hook.name: FlowPadCurveHook
hook.description: A bonding-curve hook for FlowPad token launches that places the entire curve supply as a one-sided concentrated liquidity position. Charges ETH fees with anti-sniper decay via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, blocks early buys during a configurable snipe-guard window, and graduates the pool (lifts max-wallet cap, starts creator vest) when the curve fully sells out.
